description: This Java source file defines the class FeaturePropertyNotModifiableException, a custom exception indicating that a feature property cannot be modified due to insufficient permissions. It includes builder methods for creating instances with specific context information such as ThingId, feature ID, and JSON Pointer, as well as methods for constructing the exception from messages or JSON objects.
